nodes.label: Electron
nodes.description: npm start on Windows needs the Microsoft Visual C++ Redistributable the first time.

nodes.label: Inarch (formerly Claude Deck)
nodes.description: Desktop app for Claude Code on Windows and Linux; lists projects and runs Claude sessions in real terminal tabs.

nodes.label: npm run release
nodes.description: From clean main on Linux: pushes main, builds AppImage locally and Windows installer in Win11 VM on Proxmox, publishes to GitHub Release v<version>. Overrides: PVE, VMID, PVE_IP, PORT, WIN_NODE, WIN_GIT.

nodes.label: REA (Reverse Engineer Anything)
nodes.description: Installed via 'npx rea-agents setup'; 'Reverse engineer...' starts a Claude session using REA on a picked app or binary.

nodes.label: Project Discovery
nodes.description: Projects come from ~/.claude/projects, git repos and graphify-out/ folders up to 3 levels below home, and manually added folders.

nodes.label: Proxmox Win11 Build VM (VM 111)
nodes.description: Reached via ssh pve as root; needs QEMU guest agent and portable Node + MinGit in C:\build.

nodes.label: inarch-screen screenshot MCP server
nodes.description: Read-only screenshot tool capturing all monitors; Linux via screenshot portal + Python GObject, Windows via PowerShell.

nodes.label: Plan Usage Bars
nodes.description: Sidebar bars for the 5-hour session window and weekly usage, using Claude Code's login; refresh every 5 minutes; Log in to Claude button runs /login when signed out.

nodes.label: Addons Sync
nodes.description: Syncs plugins, marketplaces, skills, MCP servers, hooks and global CLAUDE.md between computers via Push/Pull; old files backed up before pull; hooks/MCP only sync between same-OS installs; home paths rewritten.

nodes.label: Installers (Inarch-Setup exe / AppImage / deb)
nodes.description: Windows installer is not code-signed (SmartScreen: More info -> Run anyway); runs without Node or Git.

nodes.label: Home view (composer, quick actions, recent sessions, project cards)

nodes.label: npm run dist (Build an installer)
nodes.rationale: Must build on the target OS because the terminal library includes a per-platform native module.

nodes.label: Auto Updates
nodes.rationale: Checks GitHub Releases, downloads, installs and restarts so installed copies need no source, build tools or GitHub login.

nodes.label: New and Changed Projects on GitHub
nodes.norm_label: new and changed projects on github
nodes.rationale: Offers to clone missing repos and pull behind repos fast-forward only, so local changes are never overwritten; 'Don't ask again' suppresses offers.
nodes.source_location: New and changed projects on GitHub

nodes.label: Screenshot 'look' gate hook
nodes.rationale: A hook blocks the screenshot tool unless the latest user message contains the word 'look', limiting screen capture to explicit requests.

nodes.label: Main Install (hub)
nodes.rationale: Only the hub computer can push, so a half-set-up computer can't overwrite the good config.

nodes.label: MCP Secret Redaction
nodes.rationale: Env vars, headers and flags named like key/token/secret/password are never uploaded; pulls keep local values and new servers get '<set on this computer>' placeholders.

nodes.label: Versioning (major.minor + commit count)
nodes.rationale: Every push builds as a new version; major.minor in package.json is bumped by hand for bigger jumps.
